title: ConversationErasure
description: The answer to DELETE /api/v1/discussions/{crew}/{conversationId}: what the gateway removed from each store that held the conversation, and what it cannot remove per conversation. On a 500 answer the same body says which stores failed; the erasure is repeatable.

threads.description: The threads of the conversation the gateway found.

history.description: Conversation history entries removed from kubemoot_conversations: 1, or 0 when there was none.

owner.description: Owner records removed from kubemoot_conversations: 1, or 0 when there was none.

discussionMessages.description: Messages removed from the KUBEMOOT_DISCUSS stream, over every thread of the conversation.

workspaceObjects.description: Objects removed from the workspace stores.

coordinatorEvents.description: Events removed from the KUBEMOOT_COORDINATOR log.

scheduled.description: Reminders and follow-ups scheduled from the conversation's threads, removed from kubemoot_scheduled.

memoryFacts.description: Crew memory facts learned in the conversation's threads, removed from kubemoot_crew_memory.

kept.description: What the gateway cannot remove for one conversation, each with why.

failed.description: The stores that could not be cleared, on a 500 answer; repeat the request, which removes what is left.
